headline: With exchange rate dollars, US economy is bigger. With PPP adjusted dollars, China is
subhead: GDP in 2025, trillions of US dollars (exchange rate) and international dollars (PPP)
source: World Bank, World Development Indicators (NY.GDP.MKTP.CD; NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.CD)
note: Exchange-rate GDP converts at market exchange rates. PPP GDP converts at purchasing power parity, adjusting for price levels; the US is the PPP base, so its two figures are identical.
